source_vs_authored.source: Retained source feature IDs, inscribed source rectangle, source height and actual same-feature source/rendered-landmark top observations. Original city coordinates, metre scale and collisions are preserved.
source_vs_authored.authored: The source building geometry, source heights, source footprint and floor_count are unchanged. Pool roofs add a fictional deck 1.55m above the normal observed-source-top +0.28m clearance deck. Four surrounding deck panels leave a genuine collision and visual opening for a sunken pool. Water is 0.18m below deck and the basin floor 1.40m below deck, still 0.43m above observed source roof. Other roof profiles keep their previous clearance deck. All facilities, proportions and amenities are authored, not factual venue amenities or surveyed roof heights.

features: sunken basin inside a raised authored deck
four solid deck panels with a real water cutout
flush deck entry and descending submerged stairs
sun loungers with towels and side tables
normal camera on both dry sides

selection: Deterministic title keywords and some highrise feature IDs; independent of EXP07 interior identity counts. This is not proof of a real hotel pool or real residential penthouse.
world_placement: Source-positioned on-demand roof cache for outdoor exploration and elevator visits. The same building roof is borrowed by the interior visit to prevent duplicate geometry. Original floor_count remains unchanged. The developer-created pool is an outdoor roof amenity, distinct from an indoor shallow spa tub.
water_design: The water is 0.18m below the authored pool deck, with floor -1.40m and actual water depth 1.22m. The source roof is retained below the basin floor. No deck floor collision covers the water rectangle. Actual deck-hole rays, descending-step entry, swim and exit validation are recorded separately from these design dimensions.
external_assets: No new external model, photo pixels or licensed pool asset imported for EXP08/EXP09. The existing authored interior surface shader is reused.

pool_layout_contract.narrow_roof_rule: Rotate the long water direction to local Z; roofs with neither valid orientation remain roof gardens. Never enlarge source footprint or increase original floor_count.
pool_layout_contract.support: Four separate solid deck panels surround a genuine open water cutout. The pool floor and walls sit below this authored deck but above the unchanged source roof. The entry is flush with the deck and descends on a real walkable support slope with visible steps and long handrails; there is no exterior tank staircase.
pool_layout_contract.outdoor_identity: Flush cream coping and water 0.18m below the surrounding deck, open sky/city views, underwater lane tiles, wooden lounge deck with towels and tables, parasols, planters, branded hotel pool entrance, outdoor shower, towel stand and life ring. Shower/towel props are game visual amenities, not new service interactions.
pool_layout_contract.deck_hole: The actual water rectangle is expanded by 0.25m on each side to form the deck opening. The four solid panels never overlap the water rectangle. A narrow flush bridge only connects the submerged entry steps at one corner.

camera_design: The former 1.55m raised tank wall caused camera retraction. The new physical wall is flush with the deck so the real pool profile publishes no elevated camera-pivot hint. Both real Space exits retain the normal pre-exit yaw/pitch/zoom and require visible character, camera distance over 1m, head in frame, clear head line of sight and collision-free camera.
